The *Bahukāra Sutta* (Iti 107, PTS It 111) is a short discourse located in the fourth section of the *Itivuttaka* within the Khuddaka Nikāya. The text expounds the reciprocal obligations and mutual support connecting the monastic community and lay supporters, illustrating how both groups benefit each other in spiritual and practical life. Modern sociological and historical studies note its citation alongside texts like the *Sigālovāda Sutta* in discussions of Buddhist reciprocal ethics between monks and householders [Tambiah 1976].
